title: Biohybrid Infrastructure Viability Across Civilizational Scales
description: Theoretical and computational preprint. A conserved, viable, multi-class infrastructure model with capture-geometry, radiative, latency, thermodynamic, circularity, gravity-extraction, transport, network-robustness, robust-viability and Pareto results. Stylised and in silico only; no claim about human lifespan or clinical use. Not peer reviewed. Known corrections are listed in README section 24.
